articles.summary: Lagos, Nigeria. November 1, 2023: Chapel Hill Denham’s Nigeria Infrastructure Debt Fund (“NIDF” or the “Fund”) has agreed to provide long-term financing to Tizeti Network Limited (“Tizeti” or the “Company”) – West Africa’s pioneer solar-based internet service provider. The senior debt facility will be used to finance the rollout of Tizeti’s state-of-the art broadband network across 15 states in Nigeria. […]
articles.title: NIDF Supports Tizeti in Nationwide Expansion of Broadband Network
